The image shows a mango leaf with irregular brown lesions scattered across the leaf surface. The spots are:
- Irregular/oval-shaped, brown to dark brown
- Distributed across the leaf surface (not confined to underside)
- Some spots appear sunken or necrotic with irregular margins
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery_Mildew)
- No black sooty encrustation (rules out Sooty_Mould)
- No bark/twig withering or gum secretion (rules out Die_Back)

The irregular, oval-shaped brown spots distributed across the leaf surface, with some showing darker centers and irregular margins, match Anthracnose's description of "irregular, oval-shaped spots all over the leaf surface" on leaves.
